# The places in src/ that write a file themselves rather than through moxi.files or
# moxi.store. `moxi-dev contract` (check 8) fails on a write site not listed here, and on a line
# that no longer matches one, so this list only shrinks as the module moves onto the
# helpers. One line per site: <path> <enclosing scope> <call>.
src/moxi_cache/drift.py Store._take_lock os.open
src/moxi_cache/drift.py write os.fdopen
src/moxi_cache/drift.py write os.replace
src/moxi_cache/timer.py append_log os.open
src/moxi_cache/timer.py append_log os.replace
src/moxi_cache/watch.py write_record open
src/moxi_cache/watch.py write_record os.replace
